# Security Policy

## Supported Versions
We actively support and patch security vulnerabilities in the following versions of MuxDB:

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability
Please do not disclose security vulnerabilities publicly on GitHub. Instead, report them directly by emailing `security@muxdb.dev`. We will acknowledge and respond to all reports within 48 hours and work with you to coordinate a security fix and patch.
